title: Angora: duplicate file finder & calmer cleaner for Android
description: Angora finds duplicate files and large files, shows what takes up storage, and helps you free up space safely. Nothing is deleted without your confirmation. Free on Google Play.
og_title: Angora: duplicate files, keep one and free up the rest
og_description: A calmer storage cleaner for Android. Exact duplicate file finder, large files hunter, and transparent storage breakdown. Free on Google Play.
ld_description: Local-first Android duplicate file finder and storage cleaner with safe verification, transparent review, and zero scareware.
h1: Duplicate files: keep one, free up the rest.
lede: Angora finds duplicate files and giant downloads that quietly fill up your phone. You review every group, and nothing is deleted without your explicit confirmation. A calm, quiet cleaner with zero scareware.
free_note: Free. Pro is a one-time purchase, not a subscription.
console_note: Simulated using Angora's conservative safety rules. Uncheck or check copies to see reclaimable space update in real time. Angora prevents accidentally selecting all copies.
screens_title: Clean storage with preview, safety, and control.
screens_sub: Analyze before cleaning. Transparent candidates, zero scareware tricks.

shot.dup_title: Keep One, Free Up the Rest
shot.dup_body: Angora finds exact duplicate files verified by byte contents. It always marks one copy to keep and lets you preview every file before touching anything.
shot.dup_alt: Angora duplicate files screen showing verified duplicates and keep/remove recommendations
shot.scan_body: A clean breakdown of reclaimable space. Nothing is selected automatically without your explicit review.
shot.scan_alt: Angora scan results screen showing clean breakdown of reclaimable storage
shot.large_body: Quickly identify abandoned videos, giant archives, and forgotten downloads taking up hundreds of megabytes.
shot.large_alt: Angora large files screen sorting files by size and age

screens_note: Screens show actual Angora Android app UI with example storage data.
storage_sub: No inflated numbers. Every file is counted once. Clear transparency into where your gigabytes actually went.
storage_fact_1_desc: Unlike low-quality cleaners that count the same cache 3 times to boast '10 GB cleaned', Angora calculates truthful byte totals.
storage_fact_2_desc: Angora tells you exactly which directories it scanned, which it skipped, and where it needs your explicit consent.
storage_fact_3_desc: Cleanup results are recorded in a local receipt. Restore items from the system trash whenever Android still keeps them.
tools_sub: Advanced tools for deep storage insights without background battery drain.
tool_changes_desc: See what grew or shrank over 7 and 30 days. Pinpoint bloated app caches and hidden download spikes before running out of space.
tool_apps_desc: Detect user-installed apps with zero activity in 30+ days. Uninstall safely through Android's native confirmation dialog.
tool_compress_desc: Compress photos and videos into compact verified copies locally on your device. Original files stay intact until you confirm.
nots: No fake antivirus alerts, RAM boosters, or battery calibration magic.
No auto-selection of personal photos, videos, or private media.
No forced popup ads before scans or during cleanups.
No all-files access overreach. All scanning runs 100% locally on your phone.
honest_body: Angora believes storage maintenance should feel quiet, careful, and respectful. Clean storage shouldn't cost your peace of mind or your privacy.
pro_title: Duplicate scanning and cleaning are free.
pro_body: Angora Pro is an optional one-time purchase, not a subscription. It removes ads, unlocks 7-day and 30-day storage change trend charts, guided review mode, and on-device photo & video compression. No recurring fees.

cooldown.what: See your battery temperature, get an alert when your phone overheats, and find out what is heating it up.
